d:
Purchased simply because it looked interesting - the cover lead me on a bit, and I didn't suspect it was an illustration centric doujin. Contains edited and unedited covers - the front cover is actually hand colored by the staff with copic marker. While most was written in August, the book was possibly published in November for Comiket 27 (Harumi Fairgrounds) to sell by December. There isn't much information on the web, however, Kohei went on to be a rather prolific doujin illustrator.

Additionals:

★From Kohei Suga:

“Uo~~~~~~… fufufu, we finally put it out~~!!
The revised edition of Y.D.T.T.O.!!!!!

Using the illustrations that received fairly good marks in the questionnaire for the original version of ‘Y.D.T.T.O.,’ and adding newly drawn illustrations, we made this book. I honestly don’t know whether it really turned out best or not, but I did seriously draw quite a lot of new illustrations~~~!!

I first thought about making a revised edition around the beginning of September, and then for about two months after that, day after day after day, I kept drawing illustrations during class~~~

Well, anyway, if everyone who bought this book with these illustrations I worked so desperately on ends up satisfied, then—

If possible, I’d also be happy if you’d send your impressions after reading (looking at) it, though~~~

Please send your comments~♡ See you again~~?”

— from K. SUGA

1984.8.6
